name: datawebot
tagline: Product search and seller prices across online shops worldwide, plus Amazon and Shopify extraction.
description: A hosted remote MCP server for ecommerce product data. `search_products` searches online shops worldwide (queries in local languages) and returns title, price, shop, rating, reviews, image, condition, link and retrieval time. `get_product_offers` returns each seller's price, total with shipping, delivery note and a direct link. Extraction jobs (`list_job_blueprints`, `submit_job`, `get_job`, `get_results`) cover search results, catalogue and product pages on Amazon in 10 countries and 1,100+ Shopify stores. Sign in with OAuth 2.0 (email approval, no password); scripts can send `Authorization: Bearer <API key>` from the dashboard instead. Free daily search allowance plus 200 free trial credits for extraction jobs.
